Our Shop

A Wicker Park chair since 2008

Tailor Barber Co. has been part of Wicker Park since 2008. The shop is built around one idea: a good cut is tailored — to the person in the chair, their hair, and how they actually live with it day to day.

That is why the consultation leads here. Come in, talk it through, and leave with a cut that still looks right when you style it yourself the next morning.

Pricing

No guessing at the chair

Tailor Barber Co. does not publish a price menu on its current site, and this concept page does not invent one. Instead, here is the straightforward proposal:

  • Choose your service in the booking form below.
  • Your barber confirms the exact price at booking, before your appointment.
  • What you are quoted is what you pay — no surprise additions at the chair.

How a Visit Works

Three steps, no fuss

1

Consult

Tell your barber what you want, what you have tried, and how much upkeep you honestly want.

2

Cut

Scissor work, fade or beard shaping — done to the plan you agreed, with checks along the way.

3

Finish & Check

Edges, neckline and styling checked together before you leave, so you know how to keep it looking right.

Good to Know

Where is the shop?

When are you open?

Prices are confirmed at booking — use the form below and your barber will confirm the exact price before your appointment. No price is invented or guessed on this page.
